ranked_facts.why: The presence of an early diastolic blowing decrescendo murmur is more characteristic of aortic regurgitation than aortic stenosis, as aortic stenosis typically presents with a systolic ejection murmur.

Bounding pulses are a hallmark of aortic regurgitation due to the significant backflow of blood into the left ventricle during diastole, leading to an increased stroke volume and subsequently, a wide pulse pressure.
